## Firm Engine persistent cases
Uploads, edits, valuations and legal updates enqueue revision-bound jobs.
Document extraction is bounded and cached. The actual Code node performs exact arithmetic.
The API blocks court document generation when mandatory evidence or rules are unresolved.
Warnings accompany permitted drafts. Final artifacts require caseworker and lawyer HITL.
No court submission node. OCR/keys stay in the local API; only calculation inputs enter Code.
Successful/error/manual execution contents are not saved by n8n.
